newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ESSEX TAKE OVER SUNDAY LEAGUE LEADERSHIP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ESSEX TAKE OVER SUNDAY LEAGUE LEADERSHIP.

text.p: Essex moved top of the English Sunday League with a last-ball victory over Derbyshire.
Previous leaders Lancashire crashed to a 114-run defeat by Worcestershire.
Derbyshire, with all their wickets intact, needed 66 to win in 11 overs at Southend but failed to keep their nerve and Paul Aldred was run out attempting the winning run off the last ball.
Replying to Worcestershire's 235 for seven at Worcester, Lancashire tumbled out for 121. Phil Newport and David Leatherdale took three wickets each.
Pakistan fast bowler Waqar Younis grabbed four for 14 to fire out Sussex for 135 as Glamorgan charged to an eight-wicket victory at Swansea.
In a rain-reduced 15 overs contest at Leicester, a speedy 46 by Neil Smith carried Warwickshire to an eight-wicket win over Leicestershire.
